{{Youmay|the Fire plants native to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]|the [[Fire Plant (Dagobah)|Fire Plants]] native to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]}}
The '''fire plant''', which grew on the [[Mountain of Doom]] on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], was the only known cure for victims that had been bitten by an [[ice-beetle]]. The [[Frost Giant]]s who lived on the [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] avoided the area where the [[Plant/Legends|plants]] grew.

The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]] and [[Teebo/Legends|Teebo]] once ventured to the Mountain of Doom to retrieve a plant. When the two Ewoks helped the Frost Giants kill a [[dragon-bird]] that was harassing their mountain, the Giants told the Ewoks of the fire plant's location.
